name: MadMax Mode
tagline: Invents new bots for you, with a tight brief and every job filed where it belongs
description: Building a bot badly means a bloated brief and responsibilities scattered anywhere they happen to fit. This writes a short, sharp character for each new one and sorts every duty deliberately into a skill, a routine or a memory. When an action carries consequences it stops and waits rather than pressing on.
author: JoePro
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
